description: Index a knowledge base directory. Source resolution: if source URL provided, clone from it; if knowledge_base/{name}/ exists locally, index it; otherwise resolve source URL and credentials from address book. Idempotent — re-installing archives old chunks and creates new ones.
embedding_description: Index a knowledge base for the first time, or fully rebuild one from scratch. Resolves the source three ways: an explicit git URL to clone, an existing local knowledge_base/<name>/ directory, or a source URL plus credentials looked up in the address book. Always archives any prior chunks and recreates the whole index, re-embedding every document. Use to add a brand-new KB or force a clean full reindex.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Installed KB identity, chunk count, and source type
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Installing and indexing a knowledge base directory
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: FileNotFoundError: directory or source URL not found. GitError: clone or branch setup failed. AddressBookError: source URL not found in address book.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify the directory exists or provide a valid source URL.
